title: platanthera brevicalcarata subsp. yakumontana
intro: Platanthera brevicalcarata subsp. yakumontana, commonly known as Yakushima-spotted orchid, is a rare and endemic subspecies of the Platanthera brevicalcarata orchid species. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to improve respiratory issues and reduce inflammation due to its antiviral and antimicrobial properties. The Yakushima-spotted orchid is used in traditional medicine to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
